joint_gap_segmentation.scope: each existing same-vehicle direction parent, after route scoping
joint_gap_segmentation.presence: union of actual AVL instants and closed APC arrival/departure intervals
joint_gap_segmentation.apc_invalid_interval: valid arrival point, else valid departure point
joint_gap_segmentation.timestamp_alias: AVL event_time only when the time field is absent
joint_gap_segmentation.direction_labels: all labels, including unknown and conflicting labels
joint_gap_segmentation.invalid_time: missing, nonfinite, ambiguous or nonexistent cannot bridge gaps
joint_gap_segmentation.unlocated: separate diagnostic child only when its parent is split
joint_gap_segmentation.source_conservation: exactly once within each original parent membership

boundary_censoring: Calendar-day context is censored at both edges; departures are never clipped. No neighbouring-day GPS loaded.
